payload.title: File:Mixosaurus Carcharhinus Comparison.png
payload.artist_html: Silvio Renesto, Cristiano Dal Sasso, Fabio Fogliazza, and Cinzia Ragni
payload.credit_html: Figure 8 of Renesto et al. (2020)
payload.description_html:
Figure description from the paper: "Reconstruction of the skeleton and body outline of mixosaurid ­ichthyosaur Mixosaurus cornalianus with the dorsal fin and the dorsal lobe of the caudal fin, as preserved in BES SC 1000 (A) compared to the body outline of the small tail shark Carcharinus porosus (B), which average length is similar to that of Mixosaurus."

References:

  • Renesto, S.; Dal Sasso, C.; Fogliazza, F.; Ragni, C. (2020). "New findings reveal that the Middle Triassic ichthyosaur Mixosaurus cornalianus is the oldest amniote with a dorsal fin". Acta Palaeontologica Polonica 65 (3): 511–522. DOI:10.4202/app.00731.2020.
